label: Illustrated Portrait
description: A portrait rendered as a drawing rather than a photograph, in the western comics and illustration register: clear line, crosshatching, cartoon flats or a caricature. The treatment slot is the whole template — everything else just gives it something to draw.
prefix: An illustrated portrait, {treatment}. The subject is {nationality}, {age}, with ({hair-color} hair in {hair}:1.15), {expression}.
suffix: Illustration Rendering: (a drawing, not a photograph — the mark-making visible throughout:1.35), (line weight consistent with the chosen register:1.2), flat or limited colour held inside the drawing, paper or board tone allowed to show, (perfect hands, detailed fingers:1.2).
negative: photographic, photorealistic, 3d render, deformed, extra limbs, extra fingers, fused fingers, watermark, text, logo, child, chibi, underage
